snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system centred on Mater Dei Hospital, with a large private sector. After the 2026 election the new cabinet put health under the Deputy Prime Minister; hospital projects promised years ago are a political issue.

minister.name: Ian Borg
minister.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Health

priorities.title: Hospital masterplan
priorities.text: The government announced a masterplan for Gozo General Hospital, St Luke's Hospital and Boffa Hospital.
